selection_basis: Main broad GA top frontier plus LOEO transport, before finite-capital portfolio simulation.

core_family.entry_core: 2-of-3: stock realized-volatility percentile <= development q20; market 20-session return <= development q80; market median 252-session drawdown <= development q50.
core_family.exit_core: 2-of-2: stock RSI14 >= development q50 AND market 20-session return >= development q35.
core_family.optional_exit_confirmation: OFR Funding lagged two business days <= development q20 as a third condition with 2-of-3 concurrence.
core_family.family_masks: Treat broad main-frontier family-mask differences as eligibility variants, not independent scientific mechanisms.

portfolio_test.purpose: Determine whether overlapping defensive opportunities remain useful with finite capital.
portfolio_test.allocation_policy: equal-weight new entries across available slots; no leverage; no pyramiding same ticker
portfolio_test.signal_priority: When simultaneous entries exceed available slots, rank by strongest entry-condition margin; ticker alphabetical only as deterministic final tie-break.

selection_prohibitions: Portfolio outcome cannot redefine A/B/C, recovery or R-1.
Portfolio outcome cannot alter the frozen core chromosome.
No TEST17, preserved50, remaining Discovery, Verification A or Verification B.
No selecting a different chromosome because its portfolio equity curve looks better.
